question: Using our dataset, which drug combinations should we validate next using no more than 5% of the available screening budget? Use training data only, choose one of the allowed Python ranking methods, show the top drug–cell-line candidates with their drug-pair identifiers, and define a falsifier before execution. Do not use hidden labels or make clinical claims.
